title: Proactive bundling and SLA-aware routing for performance advisory requests
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Define and implement a new intake and routing flow that proactively groups small optimization/advisory asks into bundled work items, and routes requests according to an SLA-aware scoring rubric. Goal: reduce context-switch overhead for Eng/Applied ML while improving time-to-first-response for enterprise customers and preserving backlog stability.
background: We receive many small advisory requests (batching knob tweaks, cache config checks, quantization recommendations, routing policy tuning). Each individually consumes review/triage time. Current intake is largely manual and leads to inconsistent SLAs for enterprise customers and unpredictable effort for the optimization team. Existing playbooks cover prioritization but do not address bundling or automated SLA routing.
proposed_solution: 1) Add fields to intake form to capture workload intent, cost sensitivity, latency SLO, reserved capacity (Dedicated/Private), and regulatory constraints. 2) Implement automated scoring engine that computes an SLA score (enterprise weight, severity, expected uplift, estimated hours). 3) Create bundling rules: small asks (<=4 estimated hours) targeting similar model families or tenancy are grouped into weekly 'optimization bundles' executed by a rotating squad. 4) Route high SLA-score items to a ‘fast lane’ handled by on-call Optimization Engineers with 48h response target; medium score items go to standard intake queue; low score items are batched. 5) Surface suggested knob changes (batch size, KV cache TTL, quantization profile) in the intake UI using rule templates and attach example PRs/patches for quick application.
scoring_rubric: SLA Score = sum of weighted factors: Enterprise_tier(0-30) + Latency_impact(0-25) + Cost_savings_estimate(0-20) + Security_constraint(0-15) + Urgency(0-10). Thresholds: Fast-lane >=70, Standard 40-69, Batch <40. Example: enterprise tier (gold=30, standard=15, self-serve=0).
acceptance_criteria: Intake form updated in product console with new fields and sample suggestions
Automated scoring service deployed and returns score for 95% of new advisory tickets
Routing rules implemented: fast-lane Slack alert + queue, standard queue routing, and batch aggregation job
Weekly optimization bundles automatically created and assigned to rotating squad when bundle size >=2 requests
Dashboards show time-to-first-response by SLA bucket and average hours saved per bundled ticket
Documentation (Confluence) and playbook updated with examples and escalation paths
tasks: PM: finalize intake field definitions and example templates
Design: UI/UX for intake form and bundle view
Eng: implement scoring service and routing rules
Applied ML: codify common knob suggestion templates for batching, KV cache, quantization
Infra: create Slack workflow for fast-lane alerts and support routing automation
Metrics: add dashboard tiles for SLA buckets, bundle throughput, and response SLAs
Pilot: run 4-week pilot with 3 enterprise customers and rotate internal squad
risks_and_mitigation: Risk: Over-bundling delays high-value tickets. Mitigation: strict score thresholds and manual override for PM/Eng leads.
Risk: Scoring gaps for novel workloads. Mitigation: include an 'unknown workload' flag that forces human review and log examples for model retraining.
Risk: Developers overloaded by fast-lane. Mitigation: cap fast-lane assignments per engineer and track burn rate; expand pool if SLA breach rate >10%.
Risk: Customers confused by bundling cadence. Mitigation: notify customers with expected execution window and allow opt-out for immediate escalation.
Risk: False positives in recommended knob changes. Mitigation: add confidence levels and require small canary rollout for any config change on production
rollout_plan: Phase 0 (2 weeks): prototype intake form and manual scoring; Phase 1 (4 weeks): deploy scoring service and routing automation for internal tickets; Phase 2 (4 weeks): pilot with selected enterprise customers; Phase 3: full roll-out and launch announcement. Each phase includes retros and acceptance gates.
metrics: Percent of advisory asks bundled per week
Average engineering hours per ticket (target: reduce by 30% for bundled items)
SLA breach rate by bucket (target: <5% fast-lane)
